value.answer: For short stretches at low to moderate doses, it looks safe. The common side effects are mild, mostly headache and sleepiness, and they go away when you stop. Long-term safety isn't well established. A preliminary heart study from November 2025 linked 12+ months of use in people with insomnia to higher heart failure risk, but it can't prove cause, it hasn't been peer-reviewed, and a later 2026 analysis found no significant link, so that one's still open. It can also interact with blood thinners and antidepressants, so check with a doctor or pharmacist first, especially if you take other meds.
